title: xwf-uwow-world
label: Brock Lesnar

won.source: the fed's own served title-history ledger

how: Won a Triple Threat match over Big Show and Rob Van Dam.
note: This reign was later unified into the ICWC World Heavyweight Championship at ICWC Capital Combat (2009) — see this title's own event history. label: Ravishing Rick Rude

won.source: the fed's own served title-history ledger

how: Defeated Vader after a hooded man blindsided the champion from behind; Rude followed with the Rude Awakening for the pin.
note: Harley Race, Vader's own manager, cheap-shots Vader mid-match and abandons ringside moments before the hooded attacker strikes — revealed after the bell as Paul Orndorff, secretly brought in by new GM Eric Bischoff. Whether Race's own turn was coordinated with Bischoff and Orndorff is never spelled out in the served text; recorded as shown, not resolved further.

title: xwf-uwow-divas
label: Natalya Neidhart

won.source: the fed's own served title-history ledger

how: Won a six-woman elimination match over Madusa Miceli, Layla, Torrie Wilson, Candice Michelle, Maria Kinellis and Lacey Von Erich, last forcing Miceli to submit to the Camel Clutch.
note: A primary-source discrepancy: the fed's own title-history ledger credits Natalya Neidhart with defeating all six other women in one elimination match, but the served Genesis show text instead depicts Madusa Miceli winning that six-way elimination outright, only to be jumped afterward by Victoria & Natalya Neidhart and forced to submit to a Camel Clutch — after which GM Eric Bischoff simply presented the belt to Natalya. Both primary sources are on record; the ledger's own holder (Natalya) is kept as the reign of record since that is how the belt was actually presented in-fiction, with this note carrying the served show's own contrary blow-by-blow rather than silently picking a side.
